name: Create an organization Actions policy
description: Create an organization Actions policy Create an Actions policy for an organization. POST /orgs/{org}/actions/policies
context:
POST /orgs/{org}/actions/policies
Create an Actions policy for an organization. Omitting `workflow_path` targets all workflows without storing an explicit condition.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body) — Request body

name: Delete an organization Actions policy
description: Delete an organization Actions policy Delete an Actions policy for an organization. DELETE /orgs/{org}/actions/policies/{policy_id}

name: List organization Actions policies
description: List organization Actions policies List all Actions policies for an organization. GET /orgs/{org}/actions/policies
context:
GET /orgs/{org}/actions/policies
List all Actions policies for an organization.
Required: org (path) — The organization name. The name is not case sensitive.
Optional: per_page (query) — The number of results per page (max 100). For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; page (query) — The page number of the results to fetch. For more information, see "[Using pagination in the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/using-pagination-in-the-rest-api)."; has_parents (query) — Include policies configured at higher levels that apply to this organization

name: Get an organization Actions policy
description: Get an organization Actions policy Get a specific Actions policy for an organization. GET /orgs/{org}/actions/policies/{policy_id}

name: Update an organization Actions policy
description: Update an organization Actions policy Update an Actions policy for an organization. PUT /orgs/{org}/actions/policies/{policy_id}
